completion:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2. Make sure that all information is up-to-date and complete.
3. Include the number of employees and their work experience.
4. Include the number of injured parties and their ages.
5. Include the total damage costs (medical, property, etc.).
6. Include the time period when all reports must be filed (all incidents must be reported within 24 hours.).
7. Include the names and contact numbers of all injuries or other issues.
